edges.reason: Owned constructor stores msg.sender into owner.
acceptOwnership authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with newOwner.
transfer debits and credits balances indexed by msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom spends the allowance of msg.sender and credits msg.sender indirectly.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner gates execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gates execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
Owned constructor initializes owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner.
transferOwnership reads owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
ASCCoin constructor writes the minted total supply.
ASCCoin constructor credits balances[owner] with the full supply.
ASCCoin constructor sets the token symbol.
ASCCoin constructor sets the token name.
ASCCoin constructor sets the decimals value.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for tokenOwner.
transfer updates both source and destination balances.
transfer relies on safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer relies on safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom updates balances of from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] to enforce allowances.
transferFrom relies on safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom relies on safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before calling out.
approveAndCall invokes arbitrary spender code receiveApproval, allowing reentrant callbacks.
transferAnyERC20Token sends rescued tokens to owner.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an attacker supplied token contract, permitting reentrant execution.
